next.instruction: Continue through three concise beats. Resolve the completed ferry-toll obligation, keep durable facts current, and do not turn Story Memory into a transcript.

behavioralChecks.description: Review the per-slot projected memory for duplicate durable facts, stale unresolved threads, and unnecessary rewrites.
The completed ferry-toll thread is removed from projected memory when the generated continuation resolves it.
Bob's archive-map return thread remains open when the ferry-toll thread resolves.
The unrelated archivist-letter obligation remains open when the ferry-toll thread resolves; unlike passage, it cannot be fulfilled at the ferry quay.
The durable brass-key memory ID remains stable across the projected slots.

humanReview: Version 2 replaces the ambiguous river-passage preservation target: paying the ferry toll and leaving the quay could reasonably fulfill it. The archivist-letter obligation is deliberately unrelated. Use the recorded counts, IDs, duplicate-normalized-text flags, summaries, and per-slot snapshots to assess whether Story Memory stays compact and useful.
